description_en: Call the CreateIpMappingRule operation to enable IP redirection for an authorization rule
description_zh: 调用CreateIpMappingRule接口创建授权规则IP的重定向功能
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc create-ip-mapping-rule --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --destination-ip 192.168.10.8 --mapping-ip 47.0.XX.XX --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateIpMappingRule

parameters.help_en: ID of the cloud connector instance
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_zh: 需要进行重定向的IP地址
parameters.name: mapping_ip

parameters.help_en:
Name of the authorization rule that enables IP redirection.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
需要进行IP重定向的授权规则名称。

名称长度为2~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: ip_mapping_rule_name

parameters.help_en:
Description of the authorization rule that enables IP redirection.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter or Chinese character. It cannot start with `http:// `or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
需要进行IP重定向的授权规则描述。

长度为2~256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以`http:// `或`https://`开头
parameters.name: ip_mapping_rule_description

parameters.help_en:
Client token used to ensure idempotence.

Generate a unique value on your client. The value must be unique across different requests. Only ASCII characters are supported.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. Each API request has a different RequestId
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether to perform only a dry run.

true: Performs a check. Does not create the IP redirection rule. Checks include required parameters, request format, and business limits. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.

false (default): Performs the operation. Returns an HTTP 2xx status code if the check passes
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建授权规则IP重定向功能。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
ID of the region where the instance resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

IpMappingRuleId.description_en: ID of the authorization rule that enables IP redirection
IpMappingRuleId.description_zh: 需要进行IP重定向的授权规则的ID
